title: Grateful Dead Live at University Hall, University Of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: DAT (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a fire‑filled 1982 Virginia show, highlighted by Lazy Lightning → Supplication → Deal and a monster High Time.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a massive sonic upgrade from the original SBD source, delivering crystal‑clear soundboard audio (aside from the first couple of songs being cut off). The performance itself is described as “sweat house” level energy with standout moments on Lazy Lightning, Supplication, Deal and an especially powerful High Time, making it a must‑listen for any 1982 Dead fan.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive, noting excellent soundboard quality and high energy performance with only minor cut‑off issues; this yields a near‑top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, high‑fidelity SBD source praised as a massive upgrade; early songs have a brief cut‑off but otherwise the mix is clear and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic, tight flow with a sweaty‑house atmosphere; the band stays loose yet focused throughout.
